BART 和 Caltrain 各自擅长什么: What BART and Caltrain do best
BART 更适合旧金山、东湾、部分 Peninsula 和部分 South Ba: BART works well for major connections among San Francisco, the East Bay, and some Peninsula and South Bay hubs. Caltrain serves the corridor from San Francisco through the Peninsula, Palo Alto, Mountain View, Sunnyvale, and San Jose. Both are useful, but neither solves every last-mile connection.
BART 官网（2026-10-14 读取）写明运营时间：工作日 5:00 到午: BART’s site (read 2026-10-14) gives its hours: weekdays 5:00 a.m. to midnight, Saturdays 6:00 a.m. to midnight, Sundays 8:00 a.m. to midnight. Clipper is the only fare product BART sells; a physical card costs $3, or you can add Clipper to an iPhone, Apple Watch or Android phone.
晚上和周末更要看实时信息：Caltrain 时刻表页面列出实时晚点和服务中断，V: Check live information, especially at night and on weekends: Caltrain’s schedules page lists real-time delays and disruptions, and VTA’s routes page lists temporary stop closures and detours.
公交和轻轨不一定是主角，但经常决定你累不累: Buses and light rail may not be the main leg, but they often determine how tiring the trip is
很多人第一次做无车规划时，只看 BART 和 Caltrain，忽略了 Muni: First-time car-free planners often look only at BART and Caltrain, overlooking Muni, VTA, and local buses. The last ten minutes to your door and the final evening connection often shape the actual experience.
坐车可以更便宜：65 岁以上办长者 Clipper 卡，坐 BART 票价减 6: Rides can cost less: at 65 or older, a Senior Clipper card takes 62.5% off BART; Bay Area residents aged 19–64 who meet the income limit can get 50% off single rides with Clipper START (Clipper site, 2026-10-14).

临时搬桌椅、小冰箱、二手家具时怎么处理。: How will you move tables, chairs, a small fridge, or secondhand furniture when needed?
没有车，区域和生活方式要一起选: Without a car, choose your area and lifestyle together
如果你没车，却住在一个什么都得靠开车解决的地方，日常很容易累。无车生活更适合集中: Without a car, living somewhere that requires driving for everything quickly becomes tiring. A more concentrated setup works better: home, work, groceries, package pickup, and basic services should fit within a manageable area.
如果你现在没车，找房时请把“离车站多远”和“附近能不能买菜”写在和预算同一层级。: If you don't have a car, give station distance and nearby grocery access the same priority as budget when looking for housing. A small rent saving can gradually be consumed by daily effort and travel time.
